highlight.title: From DevOps to DevEx: The Platform Engineering Revolution
highlight.summary: Platform engineering has emerged as a critical discipline reshaping how organizations approach developer productivity. According to the 2024 DORA Report, teams focusing on developer experience through platform engineering see 30-40% improvements in productivity and 50% faster onboarding times.

resources.title: Draft.dev's Best Engineering Blogs for 2026
resources.why_now: With the rapid evolution of tech, staying current through quality engineering blogs is more crucial than ever. This comprehensive evaluation scores 30 engineering blogs on technical depth and usefulness, helping developers focus their learning time on the highest-quality sources.

resources.title: Frontend Masters: Premium Learning Courses
resources.why_now: As highlighted in recent learning resource reviews, Frontend Masters features courses from industry experts at Netflix, Spotify, and Google. With the increasing complexity of modern development, having access to real-world expertise from top-tier companies is becoming essential for skill advancement.

resources.title: The 2024 DORA Report on AI and Platform Engineering
resources.why_now: This year's DORA research reveals critical insights about AI's complex impact on developer productivity and the growing importance of platform engineering. With 39% of developers expressing low trust in AI-generated code, understanding these nuanced findings is essential for teams navigating the AI integration landscape.

resources.title: GitHub's Professional Programming Resource Collection
resources.why_now: This curated collection addresses the increasing need for structured learning paths in an industry overwhelmed with scattered resources. As software complexity grows, having a well-organized repository of proven learning materials becomes invaluable for both junior and senior engineers.

claude_take: The engineering landscape in 2024 is defined by a fascinating tension: while AI promises to boost productivity, developer trust in AI-generated code remains surprisingly low. Platform engineering has emerged as the antidote to increasing complexity, focusing on developer experience rather than just operational efficiency. The abundance of learning resources now requires curation—quality trumps quantity as teams seek trusted, expert-led content over endless tutorials.
